  ROUND(CAST((t.totaldeliverytons / d.hubcaptons) * t.deliverysuccessrate * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate/100) * 100 AS numeric), 2) as lpm
FROM operations o 
JOIN distributionhubs d ON o.opshubref = d.hubregistry

LIMIT 5;

SELECT o.opsregistry, d.hubcaptons, t.totaldeliverytons, t.deliverysuccessrate, t.vehiclebreakrate,
  ROUND(CAST((t.totaldeliverytons / d.hubcaptons) * (t.deliverysuccessrate/100) * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate/100) * 100 AS numeric), 2) as lpm
FROM operations o 
JOIN distributionhubs d ON o.opshubref = d.hubregistry 
JOIN transportation t ON d.hubregistry = t.transporthubref 
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN ROUND(CAST((t.totaldeliverytons / d.hubcaptons) * t.deliverysuccessrate * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate/100) * 100 AS numeric), 2) > 90 THEN 'Above 90'
    WHEN ROUND(CAST((t.totaldeliverytons / d.hubcaptons) * t.deliverysuccessrate * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate/100) * 100 AS numeric), 2) BETWEEN 40 AND 90 THEN '40-90'
    ELSE 'Below 40'
  END as score_range,
  COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM operations o 
JOIN distributionhubs d ON o.opshubref = d.hubregistry 
JOIN transportation t ON d.hubregistry = t.transporthubref
